toolDefinitions.name: pipeline-inspect
toolDefinitions.description: Inspect the saved configuration, execution history and outputs of an asset pipeline.

toolDefinitions.name: pipeline-change
toolDefinitions.description: Configure, execute, select outputs or fork a pipeline checkpoint.

toolDefinitions.name: pipeline-upload
toolDefinitions.description: Import an image, mesh or motion GLB into durable pipeline storage.

toolDefinitions.name: pipeline-artifact
toolDefinitions.description: Download or preview a pipeline artifact.

description.en: Create, inspect and refine 3D assets from text or images, with saved execution history.
description.de: 3D-Assets aus Text oder Bildern erstellen, prüfen und verfeinern, mit gespeichertem Ausführungsverlauf.
description.es: Crea, inspecciona y perfecciona recursos 3D a partir de texto o imágenes, con un historial de ejecución guardado.
description.fr: Créez, inspectez et affinez des ressources 3D à partir de texte ou d’images, avec un historique des exécutions enregistré.
description.id: Buat, periksa, dan sempurnakan aset 3D dari teks atau gambar, dengan riwayat eksekusi tersimpan.
description.it: Crea, ispeziona e perfeziona risorse 3D da testo o immagini, con una cronologia delle esecuzioni salvata.
description.ko: 텍스트나 이미지로 3D 에셋을 만들고 검사하고 다듬으며 실행 기록을 저장합니다.
description.pt-BR: Crie, inspecione e refine recursos 3D a partir de texto ou imagens, com histórico de execução salvo.
description.zh-CN: 根据文本或图像创建、检查和优化 3D 资产，并保存执行历史。
